# Synapse 2.0.18

Synapse AI rebuilds a workflow from a screenshot sent under the Agent Builder line, `synapse upgrade` waits until the new version can be installed before it stops anything, and a failed upgrade tells you Synapse is still stopped and how to start it again.

## Fixed

- **A screenshot sent under the Agent Builder line is rebuilt.** Sent with a screenshot of the workflow and nothing pasted under it, the "Move a workflow from OpenAI Agent Builder" line was answered "Nothing was pasted under the line". Synapse AI now plans the workflow from the screenshot, and you read the plan before anything is built.
- **`synapse upgrade` waits until the new version can be installed.** In the first minutes after a release, an upgrade could announce the new version, stop Synapse, back up the database, and then fail because the package index it installs from had not caught up yet. It now asks that index first. If the version is not there yet, it says "Synapse 2.0.18 is still reaching PyPI. Nothing was changed; try again in a few minutes." and stops nothing. A package index set in an environment variable is the one asked; if a uv or pip configuration file names an index, or an extra index or find-links is set, the upgrade goes ahead as before, without this check.
- **A failed upgrade says Synapse is still stopped.** An upgrade stops a running Synapse before it installs, and when the install then failed, nothing said Synapse had stayed stopped. The failure now ends with "Synapse was stopped for the upgrade and is still stopped." and how to start it again. When the database wasn't touched, it also says your data is as it was.

Upgrades made with uv, and the first run after an npm install, get the last two fixes with this release. Upgrades made with pip, and the npm command that `synapse upgrade` prints, get them from the next release, because those run the version you already have.

## Install

**macOS and Linux**

```bash
curl -LsSf https://synapseorch.com/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://synapseorch.com/install.ps1 | iex
```

<details>
<summary>npm, pip or Docker</summary>

```bash
npm install -g synapse-orch-ai && synapse
pip install synapse-orch-ai && synapse         # Python 3.11–3.14 and Node.js 20.9+
```

For Docker, see [Docker](https://docs.synapseorch.com/getting-started/docker): the image is `synapseorchai/synapse-ai:2.0.18`, also `:latest`.
</details>

## Upgrading

- **From 2.0.x:** run `synapse upgrade`. Your data stays where it is, and the database is backed up first.
- **From 1.x:** run `synapse upgrade` on your 1.x install. It moves you to 2.0 the same way 2.0.0 did; read the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for what changes.
